children: Frankfurt am Main, September 04, 2026-- Moody's Ratings has today affirmed Gestamp Automocion, S.A.' s Ba2 long-term corporate family rating and its Ba2-PD probability of default rating. Concurrently, we affirmed the Ba2 instrument rating on the backed senior secured notes due 2030 issued by the company. The outlook has been changed to positive from stable.

title: Moody's Ratings changes outlook of Gestamp to positive from stable; affirms Ba2 CFR
